stemMd: After blood glucose rises following a meal, which hormone normally promotes glucose uptake and storage?
explanationMd: Pancreatic beta cells release insulin in response to increased blood glucose. Insulin promotes uptake in responsive tissues and storage, including glycogen synthesis. These actions help return glucose toward its usual range, an example of negative feedback.

distractorRationale.e: Glucagon generally promotes mobilization of stored fuels and raises blood glucose.
distractorRationale.d: Melatonin is mainly involved in circadian signalling.
distractorRationale.b: This hormone chiefly regulates renal water retention.
distractorRationale.a: This hormone chiefly regulates calcium balance.
